metadata.purpose: Designed to support HIPAA Privacy Rule §164.530(j) and Security Rule §164.312 administrative-safeguard workflows. Not a compliance attestation. Verdifax provides the policy mechanism; the customer's privacy officer attests compliance for their use case.
metadata.intended_audience: Covered entities and business associates handling PHI through Verdifax-orchestrated AI execution.
metadata.what_this_does: Refuses admission when the caller fails to declare actor identity, role, authorization basis, model provenance, or risk classification. Produces a sealed AttestationGapReceipt naming the gap.
metadata.what_this_does_not_do: This profile is NOT a HIPAA compliance certification. HIPAA compliance requires a documented privacy program, business associate agreements, breach-notification procedures, and other process controls outside Verdifax's scope. Customers should treat this profile as one technical control inside a larger compliance program.
